changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO person_active_period ( tenant_id, id, person_id, valid_from, valid_to ) SELECT person.tenant_id, nextval('person_active_period_id_seq') as id, person.id as person_id, earliest_activity.start_date::timestamptz as valid_from, CASE WHEN inactive_person.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN latest_activity.start_date::timestamptz ELSE NULL END as valid_to FROM person JOIN ( SELECT person_id, MIN(start_date) as start_date FROM ( SELECT person_id, start_date FROM application UNION ALL SELECT person_id, start_date FROM sick_note UNION ALL SELECT person_id, valid_from as start_date FROM working_time UNION ALL SELECT person_id, start_date FROM overtime ) activity GROUP BY person_id ) earliest_activity ON earliest_activity.person_id = person.id JOIN ( SELECT person_id, MAX(start_date) as start_date FROM ( SELECT person_id, start_date FROM application UNION ALL SELECT person_id, start_date FROM sick_note UNION ALL SELECT person_id, valid_from as start_date FROM working_time UNION ALL SELECT person_id, start_date FROM overtime ) activity GROUP BY person_id ) latest_activity ON latest_activity.person_id = person.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT person_id FROM person_permissions WHERE permissions = 'INACTIVE' ) inactive_person ON inactive_person.person_id = person.id;
